title: The Window Lever: Longer Observation Windows Outweigh the Observed Effects of Data, Capacity, and Architecture in Customer Behavior Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.26521v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In our experiments on long-horizon customer-behavior forecasting, a longer observation window outweighed the observed effects of more data, more capacity and newer architectures. The window is the weeks of history a model sees before the week it forecasts from. Going from an 8- to a 16-week window adds a raw +0.070 to 0.107 log-space $R^2$ in every family at 1M. Matched test cohorts, which score the same customer-weeks at every window, show this raw comparison understates the gain in every family they cover. The direction holds on five public datasets, four spanning over a year (ridge and our transformer on all five). On our internal data, longer windows admit up to 10% more and colder training customers, which matching does not fix. Our design does not separate window length from calendar coverage, because every test anchor (the week a forecast is made from) falls in one eight-week band. translated_title: 窗口杠杆：在客户行为预测中，更长的观察窗口的影响超过数据量、模型容量与架构的效果
translated_abstract: 在我们关于长时程客户行为预测的实验中，更长的观察窗口所产生的效果超过了更多数据、更大模型容量和更新架构所带来的效应。所谓窗口，是指模型在预测目标周之前能观察到的历史周数。在100万客户规模下，将窗口从8周延长到16周，在所有模型族中都带来了 +0.070 到 0.107 的对数空间 R² 原始提升。匹配测试队列（在每个窗口下对相同的客户-周进行评分）表明，这种原始比较实际上低估了其涵盖的每个模型族的增益。这一方向性结论在五个公开数据集上均成立，其中四个数据集的时间跨度超过一年（岭回归和我们的transformer在全部五个数据集上进行了验证）。在我们的内部数据上，更长的窗口允许纳入最多多10%的、更“冷”（历史更少）的训练客户，而匹配方法无法消除这一效应。我们的设计并未将窗口长度与日历覆盖范围分离开，因为每个测试锚点（即进行预测的周）都落在同一个八周区间内。在训练期锚点上，每周岭回归……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 在长时程客户行为预测中，将观察窗口从8周延长到16周所带来的性能提升超过了增加数据量、扩大模型容量或采用新架构的效果，且匹配测试表明这一增益甚至被原始比较所低估。
en_tdlr: In long-horizon customer behavior forecasting, extending the observation window from 8 to 16 weeks yields gains that outweigh the effects of more data, greater model capacity, and newer architectures, with matched test cohorts showing the raw comparison even understates the benefit.
